target_customer: general contractors and Division 8 (doors, frames, hardware) subcontractors who estimate bids
problem: Division 8 takeoffs mean manually reading hundreds of pages of specs and hardware sets, and a missed door or hardware group can ruin a bid's margin.
business_model: B2B SaaS for estimators (pricing not found)
product_category: AI construction takeoff and estimating (originally an AI documentation scribe for superintendents)

founders.name: Arvind Veluvali
prior_employers: an AI company that had raised $45MM (sales and operations)
previous_startups: a political tech company (founded and sold)
founders.background_notes: Also worked in venture capital and product, per YC page.

founders.name: Akhil Gupta
prior_employers: Lumen Energy (18 months, commercial solar software)
founders.background_notes: LLM work since 2018; renewables construction since 2022.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading long spec documents and cross-referencing hardware sets into schedules needs document AI with high accuracy (company claims 99%); standard applied-AI work with domain-specific hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Company says it has processed 3,000+ takeoffs and wants to be the system of record for the trade, but no exclusive data or lock-in is evidenced and other AI estimating startups (e.g. Bild AI) appeared in 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Procore and ACC are integration partners for the original scribe product, not shown to have copied Fresco; Bild AI raised a $3.1M seed led by Khosla in July 2025 for AI takeoffs.

market_need_then: Launch post says superintendents spend up to 3 hours a day on documentation, and the YC page says Division 8 estimating is manual; both are company claims, not independently measured.

pivots.from: AI scribe that turns narrated site video into reports for construction superintendents (launch post, about two years before 2026)
pivots.to: AI takeoff and estimating for Division 8 construction
pivots.why: not stated in sources; the company describes Division 8 as a beachhead where incumbents have not solved the problem

outcome_analysis: Fresco is a two-person YC Fall 2024 company that started as an AI documentation scribe for superintendents and now sells AI takeoff for Division 8 estimating, claiming 3,000+ takeoffs, 99% accuracy and 70% time savings. No funding was found and it is too early to judge; competitors such as Bild AI raised seed money in 2025, so the main questions are whether the niche is large enough and whether early traction converts into capital.
notes: Funding unknown, not zero (DataDrivenAEC says total not publicly disclosed). Traction figures are company claims. No competitor sources dated near the batch (Fall 2024) were found; Bild AI (July 2025) is later and is noted in takeover_risk_then. Pivot date unknown. Some search results describe a different 'Fresco AI' chatbot product; not used.
